reviews.review:
Superbot. The seventh and hardest to unlock character. A former April fools joke turned into the most fun, coolest, unique, badass and overpowered thing in the entire game.
Well done. Well ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ done.

What a fun roguelite FPS! This one doesn't get extremely in-depth with builds, but there's a huuuge amount of guns to try out, all different, and the route selection allows you to keep playtroughs varied even if there's not much level layout randomization here.

General premise is that you're a guardian robot guiding humans (well, one human girl at the moment actually) to a city that's meant to be a utopia. Except it's all full of evil robots that attack you, and humans aren't welcome. So you shoot them! There's some classes to select form here, for that, and they got different melee attacks and specials, plus special perks, but while there's plenty of very obvious and fun synergies there, a lot more variety comes from many other things, like the huge variety of guns each of which has a unique effect or quirk that makes it distinct, even all the assault rifles got something to make them stand out between them, then there's additional modifiers slapped onto guns, items with bonuses, routes to take, secret items that stay with you between playtroughs after unlock, etc. And you get to switch up things during a single a lot too, like going for stronger guns as your current one won't keep up.

Coolest thing here is just cool exciting and quick battles go, you get to leap and dodge a lot, then aggressive play is rewarded and it's just both visually and in play so good to charge into enemies dodging their attacks, jumping on their heads and pulling off both weapon and special ability attacks. Levels in general look nice, there's lots of flair and also variation between them, and their layouts featuring some nice bits like rails to grind on for faster movement or jump pads.

If I was to give any complaints it's that the item seem kinda dull, mostly, there's a lot of 10/20% bonus when X and 50% bonus under condition sorts of items, even if these aren't as essential as in other roguelites I just wish there were more fun bits there. There's some "corrupted" items with downsides that you'd think would be a game changer but I don't really feel like gambling 5% of getting a debiliating debuff when reloading, these are really hit and miss. Also not the biggest fan of enemies designs, these generic sterile round robots aren't the most appealing of styles but it fits with rest of game so whatever.

I totally recommend this one if you're looking for a fun very repalyable FPSes to try whenever you got time for it, this is a perfect fit, varied and plays wonderfully!
best fps roguelite i've ever played
turn on jams and go at it. trust.
